verses.1: And Moses said, “They will not believe me, and they will not listen to my voice. For they will say, ‘The LORD does not show us any sign.’”
verses.2: And the LORD said to him, “What is this you have in your hand?” And he replied, “A mat.”
verses.3: And he said, “Throw him into the ground.” So they threw him into the ground. And he became a snake. Then Moses stepped forward from behind him.
verses.4: And the LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand and grasp it by its tail.” So he stretched out his hand and grasped it firmly. It became a staff for him to use as a guide.
verses.5: So that they may believe that Jehovah, the God of their ancestors, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, appears to us.
verses.6: And Jehovah said to him, “Yet again, bring your hand over your breast.” So he brought his hand over his breast. And there was a wound on his hand, just like snow.
verses.7: And he said, “Put your hand to your lap.” So he put his hand to his lap. Then she took her hand from her lap. And behold, her skirt was back on its place again.
verses.8: And if they do not believe you, and if they do not listen to the first voice, then they will believe the second voice.
verses.9: And if they do not believe these two commandments, and if they do not listen to your voice, then take water from the sky, and pour it into the vessels. The water will become blood in those vessels.
verses.10: And Moses said to Jehovah, “My Lord, no one else can speak like me. I am the only one who can speak. From the time you began to speak to your servants, I have been able to speak clearly and effectively.”
verses.11: And the LORD said to him, “Whoever has placed a mark on a person, or whoever has created a flaw in their body, or whoever has made them look ugly, I, the LORD, will surely deal with them.”
verses.12: And now, go; I will be with you, and I will guide you along the path you have chosen.
verses.13: And He said to me, “O Adonai, send it through the hand of one who is capable of sending it.”
verses.14: And Jehovah struck Moses’ face, and he said, “Surely Aaron, your brother, is a prophet. I know that he will speak. And now, he is going to come to you and worship before you. He will be happy in his heart.”
verses.15: And you spoke to him, and you put those words into his mouth. And I will be with you and with him, and I will teach you what you are to do.
verses.16: And he will speak to you to the people. He will be your mouthpiece, and you will be his mouthpiece to them.
verses.17: And take this staff in your hand, and use it to carry out these tasks.
verses.18: And Moses went and sat down by the side of his father-in-law. He said to him, “Go ahead, and return to your brothers in Egypt. I will go and see if the people are still alive.” Then Yitro told Moses, “Go in peace.”
verses.19: And the LORD said to Moses, “Go back to Egypt. All those people who are seeking your soul have died.”
verses.20: And Moses took his wife and his children, and mounted them on the donkey. Then he settled in Egypt. Moses also took the Ark of God with him.
verses.21: And the LORD said to Moses, “When you go back from Egypt, see to all those tasks I have given you. You must carry them out before Pharaoh. But I will strengthen your heart so that you won’t be able to send the people away.”
verses.22: And you said to Pharaoh, “As the Lord has said, ‘My son, Israel.’”
verses.23: And he said to you, “Send my son and let him serve me. Now, I will kill your son in your place.”
verses.24: And it happened on the road, in the wilderness. Then Jehovah met him and demanded that he be killed.
verses.25: And she took a stick and struck her child’s head. Then she touched his feet and said, “You are indeed a bloodthirsty person.”
verses.26: And then, she said, “Give blood to those who are bleeding.”
verses.27: And Jehovah said to Aaron, “Go and meet Moses on the mountain.” So he went and met him on the mountain. Then Jehovah embraced him.
verses.28: And Moses told Aaron all the words of Jehovah, and all the commands that He had given him.
verses.29: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered all the elders of the children of Israel.
verses.30: And Aaron spoke out all the words that Jehovah had spoken to Moses. He made these signs visible for the people to see.
verses.31: And the people believed and obeyed, because Jehovah had commanded the children of Israel. And when He saw their hardships, He felt compassion for them and bowed down in respect.
